description: This Python source file defines classes and functions related to Amazon Nova Canvas image generation on AWS Bedrock. It includes configuration management, request transformation, parameter mapping, response processing, and cost calculation for different image generation tasks such as text-to-image, inpainting, and color-guided generation.

classes.name: AmazonNovaCanvasConfig
classes.description: Provides configuration details, parameter validation, and request/response transformation methods for Amazon Nova Canvas models on AWS Bedrock.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of the class's configuration parameters, excluding methods and special attributes.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(cls, model: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters: 'n', 'size', 'quality'.

methods.name: bool _is_nova_model(cls, model: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Checks if a given model string corresponds to a Nova Canvas model by looking for the substring 'amazon.nova-canvas'.

methods.name: AmazonNovaCanvasRequestBase transform_request_body( cls, text: str, optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Transforms input text and parameters into a specific Amazon Nova Canvas request object based on task type.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params(cls, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Maps general OpenAI-style parameters to Bedrock-specific parameters, handling size, n, and quality.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_response_dict_to_openai_response( cls, model_response: ImageResponse, response_dict: dict )
methods.description: Converts a model response dictionary to an OpenAI-style ImageResponse object with images.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( cls, model: str, image_response: ImageResponse, size: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost of image generation based on model info, number of images, and optional parameters.
